hook: Is bus mein solah log nahi... sirf tum zinda ho!
feedback: Great structure and strong implementation of the requested format. The flash-forward cold open (I1 to I2) works exceptionally well for Instagram retention. The twist landing on the waterlogged photo (I7) combined with the emotional farewell from Aarav (I9) strikes the right balance between tragedy and horror. The visual framing notes are well-detailed with proper atmospheric blue/cold lighting contrast.
lines: Is bus mein solah log nahi... sirf tum zinda ho!
Par Simran ko sach thik teen baje pata chala...
Satpura Ghat ke kohre mein ek purani bus chal rahi thi.
Simran apne chote bhai Aarav ko shawl mein lapet rahi thi.
Uska badan barf jaisa thanda tha.
Raat teen baje bus ruk gayi... aur conductor ne Aarav ka naam pukara.
Conductor ne Simran ki taraf ek bheega hua photo badhaya...
Teen saal pehle... Aarav nadi mein doob chuka tha.
Simran ne piche dekha... puri bus ekdam khali thi.
Raat teen baje bus ki paas wali seat thandi lage... to mudkar mat dekhna.
